First, note the given date: 09-05-1239 means May 9, 1239 (DD-MM-YYYY format as implied by the subtraction phrasing).  
48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Add 2 more days → total subtract 338 days.  

1239 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1239 not divisible by 4).  
From May 9, 1239, go back 338 days:  

Step back to April 30, 1239: 9 days (May 9 → May 1 = 8 days back, plus 1 more to April 30 = 9 days back).  
Remaining days: 338 − 9 = 329 days left to go back.  

From April 30, 1239, go to Jan 1, 1239: Jan (31) + Feb (28) + Mar (31) + Apr (30) = 120 days from Jan 1 to April 30.  
So from April 30 back to Jan 1 is 120 days.  
329 − 120 = 209 days left to go back from Jan 1, 1239.  

Go into previous year 1238. 1238 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in 1238: 365.  
From Jan 1, 1238, go back 209 days:  
209 days before Jan 1, 1238 = 365 − 209 = 156 days into 1238 starting from Jan 1.  

156 days into 1238:  
Jan 31 → 31  
Feb 28 → 59  
Mar 31 → 90  
Apr 30 → 120  
May 31 → 151  
June: 156 − 151 = 5 → June 5, 1238.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1238-06-05
